The caterpillar zigzags outward, and each leg ends at the next uneaten fruit. At weight w his speed is 2^(-w), so a leg of length d takes d·2^w days.

| Leg | Weight at start | Distance | Time (days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 → 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 |
| 1 → −1 | 1 | 2 | 4 |
| −1 → 2 | 2 | 3 | 12 |
| 2 → −2 | 3 | 4 | 32 |
| −2 → 3 | 4 | 5 | 80 |
| 3 → −3 | 5 | 6 | 192 |
| −3 → 4 | 6 | 7 | 448 |
| 4 → −4 | 7 | 8 | 1024 |
| −4 → 5 | 8 | 9 | 2304 |
| 5 → −5 | 9 | 10 | 5120 |

After the last leg he has eaten 10 fruits and weighs 10 pounds.

Total time: 1 + 4 + 12 + 32 + 80 + 192 + 448 + 1024 + 2304 + 5120 = 9217 days.

ANSWER: 9217
